title.narrative: Assam: School Education and Adolescent Wellbeing Project (ASAP)

description.narrative: The project will support early childhood care and education for improved school readiness and foundational learning outcomes; enhance school capabilities to improve quality and access to school education; and strengthen the delivery of measures for adolescent well-being.
To improve students foundational learning and school-to-work transition of adolescents.
